verdict.rationale: Deel Immigration is a SaaS platform, so user-defined recurring jobs or workflows are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows only adjacent features. Automated renewal and visa-expiry reminders are system-generated alerts, not recurring jobs a user schedules. One-click meeting booking with a case manager is a one-off action, not a recurring schedule. No documented capability exists for users to define or schedule recurring workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
